notes.title: Barrage Fantasia v1.0.1
notes.content:
V1.0.1
・ Fixed a bug that the time for stage 5 was not included in the final score
・ Fixed a bug in the star requirements for on final score
・ Changed the use of skull bullets by the 3rd boss and mid bosses.
	- Transparency is now fixed between appearing on screen and moving when no shot is taken.
	- Removed bomb resistance
・ 3rd boss, 1st pattern adjustment
	- Reduced missile durability (120 → 40)	
・ 3rd boss, 2nd pattern adjustment
	- Increased the time from the appearance of the skull bullet to the start of movement (1 second)
     - Reduced the number of skull bullets by 1
     - Reduced the number of red bullets at the opening
   - Correction of the explanation column of the config
